title: NotPrincipal with Deny
question: Which principals does a NotPrincipal Deny exclude? AWS says it "might validate the account first", depending on the service. The analyzer refuses NotPrincipal. The simulator's caller can only be an IAM user here, not a role session.

cases.name: names_the_caller
cases.description: NotPrincipal names user kwong, and kwong is the caller.

readings.ALLOW: only the user is checked, so the Deny skips kwong
readings.EXPLICIT_DENY: the account is checked first, and it isn't excluded

cases.name: names_the_account_and_the_caller
cases.description: NotPrincipal names the account and user kwong, and kwong is the caller.

cases.name: names_the_account_and_another_user
cases.description: NotPrincipal names the account and user kwong, and alee is the caller.

readings.ALLOW: naming the account excludes everyone in it
readings.EXPLICIT_DENY: only the users it names are excluded

cases.name: names_another_user_control
cases.description: NotPrincipal names user kwong, and alee is the caller.
